text.description_html:
AHI SIG720-630 Satin Stainless Rectangular Flush Pull

A stainless steel flush pull, it is extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. It needs little looking after and does not degrade in appearance or function with use. This Rectangular Satin Stainless Steel Flush Pull will fit back to back on a 1-3/8" thick sliding door. For use on pocket doors, sliding doors, cabinet doors--any door where a "flush with the door face" pull is desired.

Specifications for the AHI SIG720-630 Contemporary Rectangular Flush Pull:

  • Material: 1/16" Thick Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Height: 4-15/16" (125 mm)
  • Total Width: 3-1/4" (83 mm)
  • Total Depth: 3/4" (19 mm)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 5/8"
  • Projection: 3/32"
  • Lip: 3/4" on one side only
  • Packaged with #6 x 3/4" satin stainless mounting screws.
  • AHI SIG720 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
